name: browser
description: Headless Chromium browser. Two ways to enable: (1) FREE — set BROWSERLESS_URL=wss://chrome.browserless.io?token=YOUR_TOKEN (sign up at browserless.io, free tier = 6 CPU hours/month, zero RAM cost on OADSON); (2) PAID — set BROWSER_ENABLED=true on a Render plan with 1GB+ RAM. Without one of these set, the skill returns a clear setup message. When enabled: navigate websites, click buttons, fill forms, extract data, take screenshots, run JavaScript.

action.description: setup: install chromium binaries (run if browser fails). navigate: go to URL. read: get page text. click: click element. type: fill input. screenshot: save screenshot. extract: pull links/tables/headings/images. scroll: scroll page. run_script: execute JS. wait: wait for element/ms. status: check if browser is open. close: close session.

url.description: URL to navigate to. Required for navigate. Optional for read.

selector.description: CSS selector for click, type, wait, extract.

text.description: Text to type (action=type) or click by text match (action=click).

what.description: For extract: 'links', 'tables', 'headings', 'images', or any CSS selector.

clear.description: Clear field before typing. Default true.
